items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: We had Basie’s band one time, this was for the cast and crew of the show.

ctx.x: Oh there was, when we were doing the Carol Burnett Show, it was done at CBS, which is down at — well you don’t know the city but it’s down on Fairfax and Beverly which is down in West Los Angeles sort of, near Beverly Hills. And they had some soap operas that were done there also. And they had these sets that were set up permanently, like a drawing room, that they would re-use and they would leave them set up permanently. And they were fully, I guess you’d say decorated, with things on the tables and

everything. And there were a couple of guys that used to go shopping on the breaks that were in the band, and they’d steal things. And these same, this same two people, there was a restaurant we used to eat at on our breaks that we’d go to and they had these huge pepper mills. They were about three feet tall I guess, or four maybe. I mean the waiter would have to stand back from the table to make it to the salad or whatever he’s putting it on. Well they stole one of those, put it under their jacket and just…
Oh gee, I’ve heard of some bad habits of musicians, but not that one.
